name: zsho.ot
tagline: Capturing moments that deserve to be shared.
introduction: Photography & visual storytelling by Yeah Jing Ze.
bio: I’m Yeah Jing Ze, a Multimedia Computing student at the University of Malaya with a passion for photography and visual storytelling. I enjoy capturing moments and emotions through event, portrait, street, and creative photography. Through photography, I aim to preserve meaningful experiences while expressing creativity.

Collaborated with cross-functional teams to optimise user experience, reducing user drop-off rates.
Streamlined backend integration and debugging processes, improving system performance by 15%.
Adopted new technologies and development practices to improve workflow efficiency.

projects.title: DanceCue
projects.description: DanceCue helps dancers practise more smoothly by allowing them to load music, create rehearsal section markers, jump to specific parts of a song, and loop sections without constantly touching the music player.
features: Create section markers to organise the parts you want to practise.
Jump straight to a specific part of a song.
Loop a section to repeat it with fewer interruptions.

projects.title: Q-dees: Shine Like a Star
projects.subtitle: Concert & Graduation 2026 · Event Photography
projects.description:
Photographed the performances of children aged 4–6 at Q-dees’ “Shine Like a Star” concert and graduation event. The project focused on capturing their expressions, movements, and moments on stage as they performed.

Through the photographs, I aimed to preserve the excitement of the occasion and celebrate each child’s participation, creating lasting memories of this milestone.
features: Children’s expressions and movements during performances
Individual moments and group performances on stage
The atmosphere of the concert and graduation celebration
